g.title: TF_EPR_PACKAGES
g.text: Packages - Packages installed and in development
The GUID unique identifier of the package
Prefix associated to the package. It is used to disambiguate unique alternate keys
A package is safe when its status is Completed, and so it can be installed in Live environments.
Whether the package has been only uploaded with the purpose of scheduling its installation
Indicates the date and time of creation
Indicates the user who has created it
Indicates the IP address from which it was created
Indicates the date and time of last update operation
Indicates the user who has executed last update
Indicates the IP address from which was executed last update
Indicates how many update was executed since its creation
